svg.title: Step 3b: convert scale bytes, then apply s1 to weight
svg.desc: PRMT and shift construct BF16 scale values; the detailed view shows one weight lane multiplied by s1.
svg.text: Step 3b: convert scale bytes, then apply s1 to weight
PRMT and shift construct BF16 scale values; the detailed view shows one weight lane multiplied by s1.
Scale path: every state is shown as bit blocks
input scale register: [s1 byte, s2 byte, s3 byte, s4 byte]
shift scale byte into BF16 exponent field for the s3/s4 lane
select bytes: [0, s1, 0, s2], then the same << 7
weight bit representation after unpacking and exponent compensation
s1 BF16 scale value after PRMT+shift
This is one representative lane. The scale tensor is broadcast to matching weight elements before the elementwise multiply.
